sources.entry: Matterbridge | Bridge between various chat protocols

summary.one_liner: Matterbridge is a chat bridge written in Go that relays messages and files between many chat platforms, such as Discord, IRC, Matrix, Slack, Telegram, and XMPP.
summary.what_it_does: Matterbridge connects multiple chat services so that messages posted in one channel appear in linked channels on other platforms. It is configured with a TOML file that defines accounts per protocol and gateways that map channels together. According to the README it supports message edits and deletes, preserves threading when possible, handles attachments and files, and can spoof usernames and avatars. Natively supported protocols include Discord, Gitter, IRC, Keybase, Matrix, Mattermost, Microsoft Teams, Mumble, Nextcloud Talk, Rocket.Chat, Slack, Telegram, Twitch, VK, WhatsApp, XMPP, and Zulip. It also exposes a basic API used by several third-party bridges for Minecraft, Reddit, and other services.
use_cases: bridge IRC channel to Discord server
relay messages between Slack and Telegram groups
connect Matrix room with Mattermost channel
link Minecraft server chat to other chat apps
how_to_run: Download the latest binary from the releases page (chmod a+x on Linux/macOS if needed)
Create a matterbridge.toml config following the howto walkthrough
go install -tags nomsteams,nozulip github.com/42wim/matterbridge (lighter build without Teams or Zulip)
Docker: see the Docker wiki page referenced in the README
notable: Supports a wide range of chat protocols, including many less common ones like Mumble, VK, and Ssh-chat
Multiple gateways can be defined to link channels across protocols
Build tags let you exclude heavy bridges (nomsteams, nozulip) to reduce memory use
A WhatsApp multidevice mode is available only by building from source because of GPL3 library licensing
caveats: Building with all bridges needs about 3GB RAM; the nomsteams tag reduces this to about 0.5GB
WhatsApp multidevice support is beta and must be compiled yourself with the whatsappmulti tag
The API is described as basic
